agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
JULY 11, 2024 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce Administrative Changes to the Agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
5.
PRESENTATION: None.
6.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
A.
Approval of June 13, 2024 Meeting Minutes
Item 6A_Draft Meeting Minutes 06-13-2024
7.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
A.
2023 Climate Action Plan Annual Report. Ryan Lamkin, CivicSpark Fellow
Attachment 7A - 2023 CAP Annual Report
8.
ACTION ITEMS
A.
June update of progress on the Fiscal Year 2024-25 to 2025-26 Work Plan and review of Commission Calendar. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Review and Approve July 2024 Work Plan Update.
2.
Review Commission Calendar.
Item 8A Agenda Report Work Plan Update
Item 8A Attachment 1 - Work Plan Update - July 2024
Item 8A Attachment 2 - Commission Calendar
Item 8A Attachment 3 - FY 24/26 2 Year Work Plan
9.
COMMISSIONER INITIATED ACTION AGENDA ITEMS
A.
Proposed Amendment to Food Service Ware Ordinance EMC Chapter 11.27 to further reduce single-use plastics. Commission Chair Cramer and Commission Vice Chair O’Connor.
Approve a recommendation to the City Council to draft and adopt an ordinance to amend EMC Chapter 11.27 to further reduce single-use plastics.
Item 9A Agenda Report - Proposed Amendment to Food Service Ware Ordinance
10.
UPDATES ON ITEMS OF INTEREST TO COMMISSION/ANNOUNCEMENTS BY COMMISSION MEMBERS/STAFF
11.
FUTURE COMMISSIONER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS Discussion of possible future commissioner-initiated agenda items, including informational items, presentations, or action items, if any.
12.
ADJOURNMENT - The next Environmental Commission meeting is scheduled for August 8, 2024.
